body: Acha! Corporate bulk thali package ke liye ek quick structure: ₹149 ka lunch thali for 10+ orders — free delivery on ₹1,500+ bulk. Main ek ready-to-send GBP post + WhatsApp menu card draft kar deta/deti hoon. Shall I go ahead? Reply YES / STOP
rationale: Merchant said 'yes good idea, what would it look like' — switching immediately to action mode. Presenting concrete package structure with specific price and threshold, offering to draft assets as effort-externalization.

body: Dr. Meera, quick heads up — Smile Studio opened 1.3km away on 8 Apr. Their GBP listing shows Dental Cleaning @ ₹199 vs your ₹299. body: Mylari — quick note: a new competitor has opened nearby. With 12,400 views/month and your loyal 42% repeat base, your positioning is strong. Best defense: fresh Google content. Your last post looks a bit stale. Want me to push 2 new posts this week — one on your weekday thali @ ₹149, one on your delivery speed? Reply YES / STOP

body: Lakshmi, quick question — which service is getting the most walk-ins this week at Studio11? Asking because bridal-trial searches in Kapra picked up last week and I want to make sure your GBP posts are pointing to the right thing. 1 reply and I'll handle the rest 👌

body: Quick one — which dish or combo is customers ordering most this week at Mylari? Asking because weekend delivery searches in Indiranagar are up, and I want to front-push the right item on your GBP. 1 answer from you and I'll draft the post.
rationale: Curious-ask for restaurant — specific to delivery trends in their locality (Indiranagar). Reciprocity (I noticed the trend, sharing with you). Effort externalization. Keeps conversation open rather than pushing a binary.

We've added a 'Resume Strong' option: 1 FREE comeback session, no fee, just book a slot. This week only. Want to come back? Reply YES / STOP
